__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Gustavus Tolski van Temeschwar, Chair of the Wolf">To commission the Office of the Lantern Wolf within the walls of Tassato as fully described in the opportunity.</quote>
==Overview==
* Creates a sinecure in Tassato Regario, [[Tassato]] as per the '''[[Battle_cries#A_Lantern_for_Wolves|Battle cries]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Chair of the Wolf]]
==Date==
* Winter 385YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 10 wains of weirwood
* 10 wains of white granite
* 60 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Office_of_the_Lantern_Wolf}}
==Outcome==
* Now that work is complete, the [[Lantern Wolf]] is available to elect by the National Assembly of the League as a yearly appointment for the first time at the Winter Solstice 386YE.
